question.text: Under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002, offences under Part B of the Schedule are considered money laundering under the Customs Act if the total value is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Part B of the PMLA Schedule, offences are considered money laundering under the Customs Act if the total value of such offences is Rs. 1 crore or more. The Trap: Candidates may confuse this threshold with other monetary limits in securities regulations. Note: Compliance professionals should refer to the current PMLA Schedule for the precise list of Part B offences and the applicable monetary threshold.
